description: The District Health Management Team in Bo District needs a visual monitor for their measles vaccination campaign. Using the DHIS2 Data Visualizer app (login: admin / district), create a Gauge chart (speedometer style) showing 'Measles coverage' or 'Measles doses given' for Bo District for the year 2023. You must configure the chart options specifically: set the Axis Maximum to 120 (to allow for over-performance visibility) and add a Target Line at 95 (the WHO target). Save the visualization as 'Bo Measles Performance Gauge 2023'.
